# hush

> Keeps secrets from reaching the model: blocked at the hook, scanned, and encrypted with SOPS and age. hush is the secrets-management employee that coding agents call through a CLI, an MCP server and five skills; it returns handles and verdicts, never raw secret values.

hush scans a repository for leaked secrets, gives the real fix (rotate first, scrub second), wires a scanner and SOPS+age setup, and brokers short-lived credential handles. It refuses the false-greens (`git rm --cached`, `sops updatekeys` alone, GCP "rotation enabled") and refuses to quote a single price as fact. Its judgment lives in `brain/`; the surfaces are thin. Boundary: sign-in and user identity are out of scope. hush consumes a machine identity and never owns one. Tagline: Issued, never leaked. Rotated, then proven. Powered by Energy.

Run it from GitHub with no clone: `npx -y -p github:naman10parikh/hush hush --help` for the CLI and `npx -y -p github:naman10parikh/hush hush-mcp` for the MCP server (stdio). Paths below are relative to the repository root.

The capability ladder: `broker (handle, no value) > dynamic short-lived cred > rotated static secret > raw static secret (last resort)`.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): what hush does, how to invoke every CLI and MCP tool, the 12-job router, the NOT-list (what is out of scope, including sign-in and user identity) and the hard handles-not-values rule.
- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): the Claude Code operating rules for this repository (rotate first, handles not values, portfolio not brand, sign-in out of scope); it imports AGENTS.md.
- [README.md](README.md): what it is, the quick start, and how to install it in any coding agent.

## Identity

- [identity/SOUL.md](identity/SOUL.md): who hush is, the secrets-expert persona (is, does, refuses), the sign-in and user-identity boundary and the capability ladder.
- [identity/BRAND.md](identity/BRAND.md): the name's reason (the word is the product: keep the secret quiet), the tagline and design tokens.
- [.well-known/agent.json](.well-known/agent.json): the A2A agent card (name, description, endpoint, capabilities `scan`, `doctor`, `advise`, `remediate`, `broker`, `tool`).

## CLI (`hush`; every command takes `--json`; exit nonzero on any finding)

- [src/cli/index.ts](src/cli/index.ts): the CLI entry. Commands:
  - `hush scan [path] [--staged] [--history] [--verify] [--mcp-config] [--json]`: the scanning stack; exit 1 on any finding (the acceptance bar).
  - `hush doctor [--json]`: this repository's secret-manager wiring (gitignore_ok, mcp_refs_ok, score and more).
  - `hush advise "<situation>" [--json]`: a verdict plus doctrine; flags false-greens.
  - `hush remediate <finding|file> [--json]`: an ordered rotate-first plan, with the scrub gated on consent.
  - `hush rotate-plan <secret-ref> [--live-connections] [--json]`: the ISSUE, DEPLOY, VERIFY, REVOKE plan.
  - `hush init [--scanner|--sops|--gitignore|--env-example]`: scaffold what hush ships.
  - `hush env-example [path] [--write]`: generate `.env.example` from the real variable schema.
  - `hush broker <name> [--ttl] [--wrap] [--json]`: return a handle, never a value.
  - `hush inject -- <cmd>`: run a child process with secrets through a file mount, never a committed `.env`.
  - `hush tool <job>`: recommend the portfolio or layer for a job (never a single price).
  - `hush runs [--view]`: show the redacted run log.
  - `hush --help | --version`

## MCP server (`hush-mcp`, stdio)

- [src/mcp/tools.ts](src/mcp/tools.ts): the 7 tools. Every tool returns a handle, a reference or a verdict, never a `value` field (O-09):
  - `hush_scan`: { findings: [{ rule, file, redacted_snippet }], exitCode }
  - `hush_doctor`: { gitignore_ok, env_example_schema_only, mcp_refs_ok, scanners_present, sops_breakglass, score }
  - `hush_advise`: { verdict, doctrine, false_green, brain_refs }
  - `hush_remediate`: { ordered_steps, rotate_first, consent_required_for_scrub }
  - `hush_rotate_plan`: { pattern: "ISSUE→DEPLOY→VERIFY→REVOKE", alternating_users }
  - `hush_broker`: { handle: "hush://store/<name>", expiresAt } (no `value`)
  - `hush_tool`: { default, alts, when_alt, billing_note }
- [src/mcp/resources.ts](src/mcp/resources.ts): `hush://brain/*`, the 6 brain files as read-only resources.
- [.mcp.json](.mcp.json): the config any MCP client can copy; it starts the server from GitHub. The development config is `.mcp.dev.json`.

## The brain (what hush knows)

- [brain/EXPERTISE-MAP.md](brain/EXPERTISE-MAP.md): the 12-job decision spine hush runs on every task.
- [brain/OPINIONS.md](brain/OPINIONS.md): the stances (always X, never Y, because Z).
- [brain/KNOWN-PITFALLS.md](brain/KNOWN-PITFALLS.md): version-pinned gotchas, each with how to detect and avoid it.
- [brain/BATTLE-TESTED-SCENARIOS.md](brain/BATTLE-TESTED-SCENARIOS.md): real, named, dated secrets incidents and their resolution (the golden-task source).
- [brain/TOOL-MATRIX.md](brain/TOOL-MATRIX.md): the default and alternative tool per job, and the watchlist hush keeps current.
- [brain/GAPS-AND-DISPUTES.md](brain/GAPS-AND-DISPUTES.md): where the field disagrees, and what hush flags rather than bluffs.
- Query it: `bash scripts/memory-search.sh "<query>"` (BM25 over `brain/`).

## Skills

- [skills/secret-leak-remediation/SKILL.md](skills/secret-leak-remediation/SKILL.md): a key was committed; rotate first, scrub second; the three false-greens (O-04, P-06, S-01, S-02).
- [skills/scanner-stack-setup/SKILL.md](skills/scanner-stack-setup/SKILL.md): set up secret scanning, a pre-commit hook or a CI check with gitleaks, trufflehog `--only-verified` and a baseline (O-03, S-12, P-03, P-05).
- [skills/sops-age-gitops/SKILL.md](skills/sops-age-gitops/SKILL.md): encrypt secrets in git with SOPS+age as a complement, with a break-glass second recipient; rotate versus updatekeys (O-07, S-04, S-05, P-09, P-10).
- [skills/agent-secret-delivery/SKILL.md](skills/agent-secret-delivery/SKILL.md): give an agent or CI a secret through a scoped machine identity, handles not values, a file mount over env (O-08, O-09, O-10, S-06, S-08, P-11, P-16, P-17).
- [skills/dynamic-secret-provisioning/SKILL.md](skills/dynamic-secret-provisioning/SKILL.md): a short-lived database credential with mandatory rotate-root; ISSUE, DEPLOY, VERIFY, REVOKE (O-05, O-06, S-07, S-09, S-10, P-07, P-08, P-13).

## Sub-agents (`.claude/agents/`)

- [hush-remediation-planner](.claude/agents/hush-remediation-planner.md): plans rotate-first remediation for a found leak; refuses a scrub without a rotation.
- [hush-tool-selector](.claude/agents/hush-tool-selector.md): recommends the portfolio or layer per job; refuses to quote a single price (G-01).

## Evals, acceptance and self-improvement

- [eval/run.mjs](eval/run.mjs): the golden-task pyramid (L1 structural, L2 binary golden tasks, L3 calibrated judge; no self-grading).
- [sandbox/run-acceptance.sh](sandbox/run-acceptance.sh): the acceptance test: `hush scan` flags a planted key (nonzero exit) and `hush doctor` reports the wiring, three times, offline.
- [workflows/rsi.workflow.js](workflows/rsi.workflow.js): the nightly, tokenless loop; it checks upstream tool versions and brain pins, reruns the evals and writes a proposal to `workflows/proposals/`; it never commits.
- [dsip.json](dsip.json): the self-improvement contract (eval-gated, no self-grading, git snapback).

## Install surfaces

- [.claude-plugin/plugin.json](.claude-plugin/plugin.json): the Claude Code plugin (skills, sub-agents, the secret-scan-gate hook, the MCP server); install with `/plugin marketplace add naman10parikh/hush`.
- [.claude-plugin/marketplace.json](.claude-plugin/marketplace.json): the one-plugin marketplace.
- [hooks/hooks.json](hooks/hooks.json): the plugin's hook, the secret-scan-gate on Write, Edit and Bash.
- [gemini-extension.json](gemini-extension.json): the Gemini CLI extension.
